description: Understand a log without reading it: detected format, number of EVENTS (a 40-line stack trace counts as one), breakdown by level, time range, the errors with their ROOT CAUSE resolved, and the most frequent patterns. Accepts a file PATH — that is how you look at a log that does not fit in your context, such as a CI log of hundreds of MB. Logs WRAPPED by whatever collected them (Docker json-file, CRI/Kubernetes `P`/`F` lines, `journalctl -o json`, OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON, AWS CloudTrail) are unwrapped first and the pieces the runtime split are joined back, so a stack trace spread over 40 records is one event; `wrapper` says which.

format.description: Force the format instead of detecting it

from.description: Which end to read if the file is over 32 MB

path.description: Path to the log file. Use this for big logs: they do not fit in a tool call.

text.description: The log as text. Alternative to `path`.

name: log_analyze
